correctness.rationale: Exact proof: full root body is difference of two simplices with central-binomial normalized volume; one missing oriented root cuts a primitive-height-one lattice pyramid with (n−2)-crosspolytope base determinant 1/2 and normalized cap volume 2^(n−3); disjoint missing graph edges have nonoverlapping signed caps, so 2r losses add. The proof checks quantifiers n≥3, r≤floor(n/2), no hypotheses beyond matching and standard A lattice. Independent exact determinant and functional tests run successfully.

value.rationale: Natural and scalable exact volume formula for a dense graph family under controlled edge deletions. Each deletion has a fixed exact loss independent of matching arrangement; the relative loss is exponentially small although Minkowski decomposability changes for every n≥5. Root-polytope normalized volumes govern adjacency-polytope solution bounds in oscillator models (D’Alì et al., Section 2.2), making the precise invariant motivated beyond a numerical enumeration.
